body.name: finitely encoded certificate instance
body.construction: \(\mathfrak E=(K,M,H,(h^m)_{m=1}^M,w,\varepsilon_{\mathrm{cert}})\) is encoded by binary integers, binary rationals, and the exact finite lists defining \(\mathcal H_0\) and its null-boundary projections; validity checks consist of rational inequalities, normalization, positivity, and list membership.
